narration: The moment you sign in that finance office, your dealer's already celebrating. They just earned a kickback from your lender — and it came straight out of your pocket.
visual: Dark background. Car silhouette slides in from left. 'FINANCE OFFICE' sign springs in below it. Amber dollar counter ticks up to $4,824 labeled 'DEALER BONUS'. Contrasting with white text subtitle: 'Paid from your loan the day you drove home.'

narration: Banks offer dealers a wholesale rate — say five-point-five percent. The dealer bumps it to eight and pockets the spread. It's called dealer reserve, and it's completely legal.
visual: Light background. Flow diagram: bank building → dealer person with tie → buyer silhouette. Animated arrows draw between them. Labels appear: 'LENDER RATE: 5.5%' and 'YOUR RATE: 8.0%'. Amber highlight box springs in: 'DEALER KEEPS 2.5% — LEGALLY'.

narration: On a thirty-five thousand dollar loan over five years, that two-and-a-half percent markup costs you four thousand eight hundred and twenty-four dollars. That's the dealer's bonus, paid entirely by you.
visual: Dark background. Two animated bar charts rise side by side: green bar for credit union ($40,419 total) and red bar for dealer ($45,243 total). The bottom portion of the red bar highlights in amber labeled '+$4,824 EXTRA'. Dollar counter below ticks up to $4,824.

narration: Eighty-five percent of new cars are financed through the dealership. Americans hand over an estimated fourteen billion dollars in dealer reserve every single year — and almost none of them know it.
visual: Light background. Progress bar fills to 85% with label 'NEW CARS FINANCED AT DEALER'. Ten small car icons appear, eight tinted amber and two gray. Animated counter below counts up to '$14.0B / YEAR' inside a dark badge.

narration: Here's the fix. Walk in pre-approved from a credit union. Negotiate the car price, not the monthly payment. Then let the dealer beat your rate — most of the time, they can't.
visual: Dark background. Three numbered steps spring in one-by-one: 1) 'Visit a credit union FIRST' with subtext about pre-approval, 2) 'Negotiate price not payment' with subtext, 3) 'Let the dealer beat your rate'. Green badge at bottom: 'CREDIT UNIONS AVG 1.9% LOWER THAN DEALERS'.

narration: Before your next car purchase, spend ten minutes getting a credit union pre-approval. That one step could save you five thousand dollars. That's your money — go get it.
visual: Light background. Piggy bank with amber shield springs in. Below it, savings counter ticks up to $4,824. CTA button pulses: 'CHECK YOUR CREDIT UNION RATE' with subtext 'Before your next car purchase →'. Follow and save for more money traps.
